first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public British National Grid physical building-footprint Polygon coordinates for the University of Exeter Forum, with explicit Forum/building-use identity bound to the same feature. The University of Exeter official Streatham Campus Map PDF identifies Forum as building 3 and visually depicts its building shape, but the inspected PDF publishes no georeferenced CRS, BNG vertex coordinates, or machine-readable Polygon/MultiPolygon for that Forum shape. Therefore the physical-footprint geometry criterion is not satisfied and no individual building record was accepted.
method_change: University of Exeter ArcGIS item-data configuration dereference -> distinct official University of Exeter static Streatham Campus Map PDF record, visually inspected as a cartographic building map rather than an ArcGIS/API surface.
